intro:
Settling into a new home in Arley? Jimmys Removals brings dependable, friendly removals assistance to New Arley and Old Arley across North Warwickshire. Whether you are shifting from a historic red-brick miner's cottage along Gun Hill, an expansive 1950s semi on George Street, or a detached rural residence off Spring Hill, our porters make your move day smooth. We utilize clean Luton vans outfitted with protective mattress sacks, quilted webbing, and power tail lifts.

From safely boxing crystal stemware to strapping white goods for rural transit, our team focuses on careful handling. We place protective floor guards across entryways to keep carpets clean from country dust. With guaranteed fixed pricing, you avoid hidden charges regardless of key handover delays.
localKnowledge:
Arley comprises two distinct settlements: the historic rural village of Old Arley and the larger colliery settlement of New Arley. Roads connecting the two, such as Gun Hill and Rectory Road, feature undulating country topography, sharp bends, and high hedges with limited passing places. Standard large HGVs can struggle with tree overhangs and roadside banks; our 3.5-tonne Luton vans are ideally suited for these country roads, providing swift, safe access directly to your property.

In New Arley, streets such as George Street and Ransome Road feature kerbside parking where our drivers take care to position vehicles considerately. Connecting to the B4098 and B4114, we plan efficient transit into Nuneaton, Coventry, and Birmingham.
travelInfo: Direct access via Gun Hill, Spring Hill, and easy connections to the B4098 and B4114 towards Nuneaton.
